View Deep EESN RMSEs on Final Test Set

Viewing and Comparing RMSEs from Tuned ESN Models on the Final Test Set

Author

Jacob Johnson and Katherine Goode

Published

May 12, 2026

Quarto document to visualize and compare the RMSEs on the final holdout/test set:

  • Loads RMSEs
  • Compares RMSE from all models

Set Up

Packages:

# Load packages
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(wesanderson)

Specify file paths:

fp_results = "../results/"

Specify target regions:

target_regions = c("MW", "NE", "SE", "SW", "W")

Models Chosen by Best Overall RMSE

Load RMSEs for reach region and horizon:

# Load the RMSEs
rmse_list_all <- list()
for(target_region in c(target_regions)){
  for(tau in 1:4){
    
    # Load RMSEs
    loaded_rmses <- 
      readr::read_csv(paste0(
        fp_results,
        "final-rmses-chosen-by-all-data",
         "/targetregion", toupper(target_region),
         "-tau", ifelse(tau < 10, paste0(0, tau), tau),
         "-rmses.csv"
      ))
    
    # Save RMSEs
    rmse_list_all[[paste0("targetregion", toupper(target_region),
                      "-tau", ifelse(tau < 10, paste0(0, tau), tau))]] <-
      loaded_rmses

  }
}

# Bind RMSE data frames together
final_rmses_all <- do.call(rbind, rmse_list_all)

# Make a column for horizon, region, and tuning settings
final_rmses_all <- 
  final_rmses_all |>
  mutate(file = str_remove(file, ".csv")) |>
  separate(
    file,
    c("target_region",
      "tau",
      "m",
      "nlayers",
      "nh",
      "nu",
      "nens",
      "groups"),
    remove = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    target_region = str_remove(target_region, "targetregion"),
    tau = as.numeric(str_remove(tau, "tau")),
    m = as.numeric(str_remove(m, "m")),
    nlayers = as.numeric(str_remove(nlayers, "nlayers")),
    nh = as.numeric(str_remove(nh, "nh")),
    nu = as.numeric(str_remove(nu, "nu")) / 100,
    groups = as.numeric(str_remove(groups, "groups"))
  )

# Write out results
write.csv(
  final_rmses_all, 
  paste0(fp_results, "final-rmses-chosen-by-all-data.csv")
)
final_rmses_all |> 
  select(-file) |>
  knitr::kable()
